Project documentation folder

Purpose
- Central place to track and version repository documentation: design notes, API docs, decision logs.

Guidelines
- Keep documentation in markdown under this folder.
- Link important docs from the top-level README.
- Small, focused files preferred (one concept per file).

Examples
- architecture.md - high level architecture and public API surface
- changes.md - noteworthy changes / decision log

This folder is intentionally simple — add more structure when docs grow.
